background_image_description: Soft off-white to light-gray vignette with subtle cloudy swirls; corners slightly darker gray (#dedede–#e6e6e6) fading to brighter center (#f7f7f7).

nodes.asset_description: Composite photo-illustration of a stylish male figure from waist up, facing left, wearing tortoiseshell sunglasses, a gray overcoat, and a black leather glove by his chin. His silhouette contains a double-exposure of a modern city skyline at sunset: a tall central spire and clustered buildings in dark silhouette, warm orange-to-yellow glow (#f5a623 to #ffd36b) radiating from the chest area. The right side of the figure dissolves into hundreds of small shards and particles (squares/triangles) dispersing up and to the right, in tones from dark gray/black to warm orange. Lower portion shows a city street receding toward the skyline. Clean white negative space surrounds the figure.

nodes.text: LARS PEETERS  |  DREW FEIG  |  SAMIRA HADID
